We need to generate high-quality unit test code for atRoot method, using JUnit5 and Mockito. The provided test class framework already includes tests for the three standard PathTypes and a custom one. However, the existing test cases also include null handling cases: config null, pathType null, validationContext null. Need to add tests for those scenarios, and possibly parameterized tests for the first group. But the framework already has separate tests. We can improve by using parameterized test for standard PathTypes, but requirement: one test function per test case group. Could keep as is but add null handling tests.

We need to ensure imports include PathType, JsonNodePath, etc. Also need to handle custom PathType: we need to know if PathType enum has CUSTOM; if not, we can define a mock enum value via a stub? PathType is an enum with values LEGACY, JSON_POINTER, JSON_PATH, maybe others. For test we can use a mock PathType via Mockito? But PathType is enum, cannot mock. We could use PathType.valueOf? Not sure. The test currently uses PathType.CUSTOM comment assume exists. To be safe, we can create a dummy enum value using a subclass? Not possible. Better to use a custom PathType by creating a new enum constant via reflection? Not feasible. Instead we can test fallback by using a stubbed config that returns a PathType not matching any of the three, e.g., PathType.valueOf("CUSTOM") if exists. If not, we can use PathType.LEGACY but then test would not go to fallback. Maybe we can use a mock PathType via Mockito: when(config.getPathType()).thenReturn(mock(PathType.class)); but then equals comparisons will be false, and fallback will happen. However, the equals checks use .equals on enum values; mock will not be equal to any of the known constants, so fallback will happen. That is fine.

Thus for custom case, we can use mock(PathType.class). We'll need to stub its toString maybe not needed.

Also need tests for null config: when(validationContext.getConfig()).thenReturn(null); then validator.atRoot() should throw NullPointerException. Use assertThrows.

Similarly null pathType: when(config.getPathType()).thenReturn(null); expecting NPE.

Also null validationContext: we need to create validator with null validationContext. Since createValidator uses the field validationContext passed in constructor. The BaseJsonValidator constructor signature is not shown fully; but the createValidator method passes validationContext variable. In order to test null validationContext, we need to instantiate BaseJsonValidator with null. The constructor of BaseJsonValidator likely expects validationContext as last argument. The createValidator method uses that variable. So we can call new BaseJsonValidator(..., null) directly.

But createValidator method currently uses validationContext field from test class (mock). We'll need a separate method for null context.

We'll add tests:

- atRoot_throwsNPE_whenConfigIsNull
- atRoot_throwsNPE_whenPathTypeIsNull
- atRoot_throwsNPE_whenValidationContextIsNull

We'll also maybe parameterize the three standard cases using @ParameterizedTest with EnumSource.

But requirement: one test function per test case group, ensuring all cases are covered. We have groups: branch coverage, null handling. Could combine standard cases into one parameterized test.

Let's restructure: Keep existing tests but we can replace three tests with parameterized test for PathType values JSON_POINTER, LEGACY, JSON_PATH. Provide expected instance.

Add test for custom fallback.

Add null handling tests.

Make sure imports: org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest, org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.EnumSource, org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.Arguments, org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.MethodSource, etc.

Simplify: Use @ParameterizedTest with EnumSource for standard types and method source for expected instance.

We'll produce final test class code.

Also need to import JsonNodePathJsonPointer, JsonNodePathLegacy, JsonNodePathJsonPath, JsonNodePath.

Make sure to use @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class) already.

Implement helper method createValidatorWithContext(ValidationContext ctx) to pass custom context.

Implement fallback test using mock(PathType.class) as custom.

Implement null config test: when(validationContext.getConfig()).thenReturn(null); expect NPE.

Implement null pathType test: when(config.getPathType()).thenReturn(null); expect NPE.

Implement null validationContext test: BaseJsonValidator validator = new BaseJsonValidator(..., null) { ... };
